issues.legal_issue: A plaint may be amended to include claims arising from events during the suit when the amendment serves the interests of justice and avoids multiplicity of litigation, even if limitation is disputed and can be decided later.
material_facts: The pending suit sought an injunction against demolition of a compound wall.
During the suit, the defendants were alleged to have demolished parts of the wall and damaged the entrance gate.
The plaintiff sought to amend the plaint to plead those subsequent events and seek relief concerning them.
The limitation objection was disputed and could be decided as an issue after the amendment was allowed.
issues.conclusion: The amendment should be allowed, subject to payment of costs, and the limitation question may be determined after the amendment.
issues.legal_principle: Order 6 Rule 17 of the Code of Civil Procedure gives courts broad power to allow amendments in the interests of justice. Under B.K.N. Pillai v. P. Pillai, courts should generally take a liberal rather than hypertechnical approach, particularly where the opposing party can be compensated by costs, and amendments may be allowed to avoid multiplicity of litigation. That decision referred to Charan Das v. Amir Khan, L.J. Leach & Co. Ltd. v. Jardine Skinner & Company, Smt. Ganga Bai v. Vijay Kumar, and M/s. Ganesh Trading Co. v. Moji Ram. A disputed, arguable limitation objection may be decided as an issue after allowing the amendment.

rule.if: pending_civil_suit and amendment_concerns_events_during_suit and amendment_relates_to_existing_dispute and amendment_avoids_multiplicity and limitation_is_disputed

predicates.pending_civil_suit: A civil suit is pending when a party seeks to amend its pleading.
predicates.amendment_concerns_events_during_suit: The proposed amendment pleads events alleged to have occurred while the suit was pending.
predicates.amendment_relates_to_existing_dispute: The events pleaded in the amendment concern the subject matter already in dispute in the suit.
predicates.amendment_avoids_multiplicity: Allowing the amendment would enable connected claims to be addressed in the existing suit rather than in separate litigation.
predicates.limitation_is_disputed: The opposing party raises a limitation objection whose resolution is arguable and can be determined after the amendment.

issues.definition: When a pending suit's amendment concerns later events related to the existing dispute, avoids separate litigation, and faces a disputed limitation objection, the amendment is allowed subject to costs.
